summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a comprehensive lecture on the core message of Islam, focusing on the concept of Tawheed (monotheism) and the principle of worshiping Allah alone without partners. He explains that while the people of Quraysh and previous nations believed in Allah's existence, they corrupted this belief by associating partners with Him through the veneration of saints and intermediaries. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes that every prophet and messenger throughout history was sent with the same fundamental message: 'None is rightfully worshiped but Allah,' demonstrating unity in purpose despite differences in laws and resources. He uses the analogy of prophets as building blocks constructing the same house of worship, with Prophet Muhammad being the final brick completing this divine structure.
